roomSummary: An open-plan kitchen and dining area featuring modern white and timber cabinetry with light wood flooring and tiled kitchen floor.
camera: The camera stands in the living or dining entry area looking past a glass stair railing toward the kitchen and back exterior door.

landmarks.description: Glass balustrade of the staircase on the far left
Dark grey exterior or passage door on the far left wall
Tall vertical window with a roller blind on the back wall
Black pendant light hanging above the kitchen counter
White kitchen peninsula with integrated sink and dishwasher
Wood-grain overhead cabinets mounted on the right wall
Built-in oven and cooktop beneath overhead cabinetry

walls.name: Back wall
walls.description: White wall containing the tall vertical window and leading to the dark door

walls.name: Right kitchen wall
walls.description: Wall fully fitted with kitchen splashback tiles and cabinetry

zones.name: Kitchen
zones.description: Tiled floor section with peninsula, cooktop, and cabinetry on the right

zones.name: Dining / Circulation Area
zones.description: Light timber floor section in the foreground beside the glass stair railing

fridgeSpace.description: No visible empty fridge cavity in the shot

layout.placement: In the open foreground on the timber floor, positioned centrally between the glass stair railing and the kitchen peninsula
Four chairs tucked neatly around the dining table
A decorative bowl and small vase placed on the edge of the white kitchen peninsula

relationships: The dining table sits in the foreground on the timber flooring without obstructing the walkway to the dark door or the kitchen cooking zone.
avoid: Do not place bar stools along the kitchen peninsula as there is no counter overhang.
Do not block the walkway between the staircase railing and the dark door.
Do not place furniture directly in front of the tall back window.
keepUntouched: Glass stair balustrade on the left
Dark door and tall window on the back wall
Pendant light fixture above the kitchen counter
